rows.en: Yes… There are Gigants out too!
It's Red Baron… So that's the Iron Mask Party robot?
…Looks like it, huh? And that nasty bunch is here too, while they're at it.

Yes, Ultra Garrison here…

What did you say!?
Furuhashi, what is it?

Well, it's like this…

It's from the Coast Guard… They say they've seen the battleship Yamato!
The battleship Yamato?
Something's strange about the recent shipwrecks…
Captain! Another SOS!
Where?
Latitude 30 degrees 22 minutes north, longitude 128 degrees 4 minutes east.
That's about ninety nautical miles south, off Cape Bonomisaki, isn't it?
Again… Amagi, head out and investigate right away!
Yes, sir!
This is Amagi!
Amagi, how does it look?
I've reached the site of the wreck, but… there's no oil or debris anywhere.
It doesn't seem like an ordinary wreck, does it? No trace at all… something's not right…
Could it be an attack by someone?

Captain! Red Baron is fighting nearby.

Its opponent… is probably an Iron Mask Party robot.

What!? The Iron Mask Party?

Sir! I believe we need to investigate this thoroughly…
The truth is, we've also had reports from Paris HQ of ships going missing one after another in the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
Chief of Staff Takenaka… I request a rigorous investigation of the Far East waters!
Mm… Shall we send out the Hydranger?
Sir! We'll begin preparations to launch at once.
What is it, Amagi?
The battleship Yamato has appeared! And now it's the Combined Fleet! What's going on?

All right, understood!

Call off the investigation! We'll go to their support at once!

Furuhashi, Soga, Dan! Sortie in the Ultra Hawks!
Keeen!
I don't believe it! The invincible Red Baron, split in two!

Hahaha… Even the red phoenix, Red Baron, has fallen before our King Deviler!

The Iron Mask Party is victorious! Deviler has won! Hahaha…
Boss! It worked, didn't it?
Ken! You're safe!
Yeah… Operation Shadow!

Operation Shadow?

So you used a trick?
That's right… That Red Baron was a fake.

Mm…

But this is the Iron Mask Party we're talking about! They'll soon realize the Red Baron they destroyed was a fake…
Isn't the upgrade finished yet?
It's almost done! I just hope they don't catch on before then…
Mari, where's Daisaku? He went to the Amigo with you, didn't he?

Now that you mention it… he suddenly disappeared…

I was sure he'd come back here…
No… The only ones here were me and the Boss!
It can't be!?

Daisaku… has Red Baron's Seven Secrets!

If the Iron Mask Party finds out about them…? All our upgrade work will go down the drain!
Boss! Let's look for Daisaku!
Right, let's split up and search!

Wait! The TDF is asking us to sortie!

Apparently a mysterious Combined Fleet has appeared out at sea… They want our help with it!

And… Red Baron's upgrade is complete! It can launch any time!
Ken! I'm counting on you!
Right!

That watch… it's a keepsake from my late father. It means more to me than my life!

So… come on, okay? Please! Give it back, okay?
There's a film reading.
No! It's just a watch…
A time-lock type, eh…
Terrible news! The Red Baron we destroyed was a fake.
What!? Say that again!

We analyzed the fragments of Red Baron and…

found they weren't Baronium, just ordinary aluminum alloy!

(Red Baron is safe…

Somehow I've got to let everyone know there's an entrance passage to the undersea secret base in the sand dunes…)
Nngh… So the SSI tricked us!?
Hahaha… Celebrating because you beat a fake!? You sure are a klutz, Deviler, old buddy!

Ngh…

Plant a time bomb inside this one's body, turn him into a human bomb, and send him close to the SSI!
To the SSI!?
The Ultra Garrison, the Security Squad… and even the Special Forces! Wow, that's amazing.

Kurenai, leave the rest to us!

Hori's missing? I heard from Mr. Ogo! Don't hold back, go join the search!

Roger!

Thanks, Furuhashi!
All riiight, let's do this!

A time bomb has been set inside your body! I can blow you to pieces with a single switch!

Your targets are Ken Kurenai and Minoru Ogo. Take those two with you!

Listen! Everything you say will be monitored! Say anything you shouldn't, and I'll blow you up on the spot!
(I'm glad I get to see everyone… but with a bomb attached, it's not much of a treat!)
Daisaku!
Daisaku! You're safe!? What happened? Those wounds…
Ah, no, it's…
That arm…!? Don't tell me?
(Boss, run!)
Heeey! Daisakuuu!
(Don't come, Ken! If you come… they'll press the detonator switch!)

Boss… I'm sorry they took something so important from me! Deviler has the wristwatch…

And also…
And also? And also… what?
(Daisaku is trying to tell us something, isn't he?)
Boss, look at this…
(Is this… writing in the sand?)

(I see… I could do that!

Thanks, Mari…)

uncertain: U11072: 坊の岼沖南方丸十海里 read as 坊ノ岬沖南方九十海里 "about ninety nautical miles south, off Cape Bonomisaki" (where the real Yamato sank). 丸十 -> 九十 is a guess.
U11078: Kiriyama speaks politely to Takenaka here.
U11111: フィルム反応 read as a film (microfilm) reading inside the watch.
U11117/U11127/U11132/U11134/U11139/U11140: whole-line 『』 thoughts rendered as ( ). U11137 has no closing bracket in the Japanese; closed it anyway.
U11119: デビラーちゃん rendered mockingly as "Deviler, old buddy".
U11122: Ken arriving at the battlefield; 特殊部隊班 rendered "the Special Forces" (UCMA).
U11138: Mari shows Ogo the sand writing Daisaku makes (rows in B0140 speaker "Sand Writing").
omissions_kept: U11130: Daisaku's evasive "Ah, no, it's…" kept unfinished.
